source.name: El Español - Estambul toma el relevo de Arabia Saudí y acogerá por primera vez la Supercopa de España
source.note: RFEF president Rafael Louzán signed the agreement in Istanbul on 17 September 2026; semifinals 2-3 February 2027 (Fenerbahçe and Beşiktaş stadiums), final 6 February at Galatasaray's Ali Sami Yen.

note: One-off hosting deal. The deal keeps economic terms similar to Saudi Arabia's, with about EUR 40m to be split among the participating clubs (El Español); whether that money comes from the TFF, the Turkish state or elsewhere is not stated - see unsourced.
